rod_fit_reason: Fit the incremental total-rod slope during early support release. The four individual rods and later release remain checks; absolute ring readings are not assembly tensions.
conditional_stiffness_reason: The existing effective-rod scenario and a doubled value test whether force/displacement channels distinguish rod flexibility from the external displacement transfer. These are conditional scenarios, not measured bounds or identified rod stiffnesses.
external_displacement_reason: After support release, fit only an affine difference between the machine channel and computed jack-face motion, then check the next force interval. Keep the fixed first reference: a fitted offset represents accumulated seating/transfer mismatch, not a new zero. This observed difference cannot by itself identify hydraulic/frame compliance.
local_observation_check: Compare the three-channel mean and permutation-invariant first angular harmonic amplitude. Do not assign instrument numbers to the virtual probe coordinates. The equal-angle harmonic does not identify cone rotation without installation geometry.
